_comment: Mutation testing for the inference critical core (docs/14 DD-4: 'mutation testing on the critical core — inference, isolation, crawler, confidence'). We mutate the PURE rule logic (r1-r13) + evaluate.ts and run the DB-free unit suites (the g12/g13/g14 + r* tests cover every rule without Postgres). engine.ts is excluded: its tests are live-PG (describe.skip'd without a DB), so mutating it here would report false 'survived' mutants. The full engine mutation run belongs in the nightly integration job where a Postgres is available.
_plugins_comment: Declare the runner plugin by name — pnpm's symlinked node_modules defeats Stryker's default '@stryker-mutator/*' auto-glob, so it must be resolved explicitly (else: 'Cannot find TestRunner plugin vitest').
_thresholds_comment: break = the regression FLOOR (CI fails below it). Set to the current measured score (62%) so the suite can only ratchet UP: any new inference code without matching tests drops the score and fails. Raise this as we kill the known survivors (refs.ts 19%, r9 51%, r10 62%). high/low are report colors only.
